title: Anima Selective Checkpoint (选择性检查点)

standard.summary: Anima DiT block checkpoint 的增强模式：'block' 标准模式重算整个 block；'selective' (SAC) 模式只重算轻量级操作（elementwise），保留重型操作（matmul/SDPA）的激活。
standard.effect: anima_block_checkpointing_mode='selective' 减少约 30-40% 的重算开销（因为跳过了 matmul/SDPA 的重算），同时仍节省显存。anima_block_checkpointing_interval 控制每 N 个 block 才做 checkpoint（N>1 时部分 block 不 checkpoint，用更多显存换更少重算）。
standard.whenToUse: Anima 训练中显存紧张但又不想完全牺牲速度时。selective 是速度和显存的最佳折中。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存充裕时不需要。selective 模式比 block 模式使用稍多显存。

optionDescriptions.block: 整个 block 重算，显存省、反向重。
optionDescriptions.selective: 轻的重算、matmul/SDPA 留着，速度和显存折中。

standard_en.summary: The enhanced mode for Anima DiT block checkpointing: 'block' is the standard mode and recomputes the whole block; 'selective' (SAC) recomputes only the lightweight elementwise operations and keeps the activations of the heavy ones (matmul / SDPA).
standard_en.effect: anima_block_checkpointing_mode='selective' cuts roughly 30-40% of the recompute cost by skipping the matmul / SDPA recompute while still saving VRAM. anima_block_checkpointing_interval controls checkpointing only every N blocks; with N>1 some blocks are not checkpointed, trading more VRAM for less recompute.
standard_en.whenToUse: In Anima training when VRAM is tight but you do not want to give up speed entirely. selective is the best compromise between the two.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed when VRAM is plentiful. selective uses slightly more VRAM than block.

optionDescriptions.block: The whole block is recomputed: saves VRAM, heavy backward.
optionDescriptions.selective: The light operations are recomputed and matmul / SDPA are kept -- a compromise between speed and VRAM.

advanced.principle: 标准 gradient checkpointing 在 backward 时重算整个 forward。Selective Activation Checkpointing (SAC) 分析每个操作的 FLOPs/内存比：高 FLOPs 操作（matmul/SDPA）保留激活不重算，低 FLOPs 操作（elementwise/layernorm）丢弃激活在 backward 时重算。anima_block_checkpointing_interval=1 表示所有 block 都做 checkpoint；=2 表示每隔一个 block 做 checkpoint（一半 block 保留完整激活）。anima_block_prefetch_mode='adaptive' 根据 blockskip 策略和在线深度自适应调整预取深度。
advanced.intervention: DiT block forward 时根据 mode 决定哪些操作保留激活。
advanced.expectedImpact: selective 比 block 模式速度提升约 15-25%，显存多约 10-15%。interval=2 进一步提速但显存增加更多。
advanced.tradeoffs: interval > 1 时部分 block 不做 checkpoint，显存占用更高。
advanced.codePath: core/lulynx_trainer/ → Anima DiT block checkpoint → selective SAC / interval control

advanced_en.principle: Standard gradient checkpointing recomputes the whole forward during backward. Selective Activation Checkpointing (SAC) analyzes each op's FLOPs/memory ratio: high-FLOPs ops (matmul/SDPA) keep activations without recompute, low-FLOPs ops (elementwise/layernorm) drop activations and recompute them in backward. anima_block_checkpointing_interval=1 checkpoints every block; =2 checkpoints every other block (half the blocks keep full activations). anima_block_prefetch_mode='adaptive' adjusts prefetch depth online based on the blockskip strategy.
advanced_en.intervention: At DiT block forward, the mode decides which ops keep activations.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: selective is about 15-25% faster than block mode with roughly 10-15% more VRAM. interval=2 speeds up further but increases VRAM more.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: With interval > 1 some blocks are not checkpointed, so VRAM usage is higher.
advanced_en.codePath: core/lulynx_trainer/ → Anima DiT block checkpoint → selective SAC / interval control
